pages.text: $(#FFD700)Tools of the Gods$() adds progressive tools, armor, and traits.$(br2)Every TOG item gains XP from use, levels up to 100, and unlocks tiers with gems. Traits are bound at the $(l:traits/smithing_table)Trait Smithing Table$().$(br2)See $(l:intro/first_steps)First Steps$() to begin.
